title: RAW UNREVIEWED: operation-first argument completion is position-independent
summary: A paid process operator may open a typed event awaiting its explicitly written patient at either initial or medial position. One frozen complement rule, rather than a paragraph-entry exception, must close the same argument slot.

design.mechanism: Instantiate the same operation P with one unresolved typed patient slot. A globally fixed operation-complement construction binds an explicit compatible participant before its written boundary. UNKNOWN or a competing event blocks completion; no previous-topic fallback.
design.prediction: Initial and medial P require the same written complement construction and arity. Initial position supplies no reset, object or execution; medial position supplies no inherited patient. All intervening groups retain their paid contribution.
design.contrast: Deferred explicit complement versus a model in which P must consume a previously introduced patient.

required_falsifier: Reject if either complete context cannot close the paid patient slot before the fixed boundary, has multiple equally eligible complements, or needs a position-specific meaning/binding exception.
exact_changed_research_decision: Choose a complete operation-first construction only if both initial and medial cases bind without extra glosses or paragraph resets.
